name: What is sub-trade coordination in plumbing for a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is sub-trade coordination in plumbing for a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sub-trade coordination in plumbing involves managing and integrating the work of specialized plumbing contractors with other construction trades on a project. As a general contractor, we ensure that plumbing installations align with the overall construction schedule, design specifications, and the work of electricians, HVAC technicians, and framers. This includes planning timelines, resolving conflicts between trades, and overseeing the quality and progress of the plumbing work to avoid delays and rework, ultimately ensuring a smooth construction process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sub-trade coordination in plumbing involves managing specialized plumbing contractors and their integration with other construction trades to ensure project alignment and efficiency.
